data.title: Aetna 2027 Medicare plans offer reliable, affordable access to care & member support
data.description: Initiatives have been created to enhance member benefits and improve healthcare access. These include no copays on Tier 1 medications and covered vaccines at in-network pharmacies. Additionally, there are no copays for annual physicals, colonoscopies, and mammograms at in-network providers. Members can also benefit from a zero copay for an annual Healthy Home Visit from a licensed Signify Health professional. These efforts aim to provide cost-saving opportunities and encourage preventative health measures for members.
